records.title: Why Does the LLM Stop Computing: An Empirical Study of User-Reported Failures in Open-Source LLMs
records.reason: The linked inference-failure lineage requires full-text review. arXiv HTML retrieval at https://arxiv.org/html/2601.13655 failed (cache miss); only the primary abstract was available, describing premature stopping/user-reported behavior rather than a tested optimization. Because full text is unavailable and the topic touches stopping behavior, retain as borderline.

records.title: A Brain-like Synergistic Core in LLMs Drives Behaviour and Learning
records.reason: arXiv abstract: studies synergistic representations in LLM layers and fine-tuning effects; it does not change inference cost, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: On the Holistic Approach for Detecting Human Image Forgery
records.reason: HuForDet uses an MLLM as one branch of a human-image forgery detector; its contribution is cross-domain image-fraud detection and robustness, not optimizing the MLLM inference path.

records.title: Robotic VLA Benefits from Joint Learning with Motion Image Diffusion
records.reason: arXiv abstract: motion-image diffusion is an auxiliary VLA training head and explicitly leaves standard test-time inference unchanged; the contribution is robotics performance, not inference efficiency.
